observations: Photo 0 shows a silver projector with the brand 'SONY' visible on the front panel. The top has a lens cover and control buttons labeled 'FOCUS', 'ZOOM', 'MENU', 'ENTER', 'VOLUME', 'SOURCE', 'POWER', and others. The device is wrapped in plastic film.

Photo 1 shows the side of the same projector, held by a hand. Visible ports include a yellow RCA (composite video), a blue VGA port, an HDMI port, and a power input. The side panel also has text that appears to read 'VPL-DX122' vertically, though it is partially obscured by plastic wrap and angle.
Both photos have a watermark: 'SAMTECH PROJECTORS POSTED ON JIJI'.
The projector appears to be in new or near-new condition, with no visible damage or wear, and is still wrapped in protective plastic.
